content: Qaraxa Qanxisiya Zakiyoosa
Yesuusi Iyaarko gelidi aadhees.
Yan Zakiyoosa geetetiya qaraxa qanxiseyisata halaqay de7ees. I daro dure.
I Yesuusi ooneko be7anaw koyis. I qanthi gidiya gisho asaa darotethaafe dendoysan Yesuusa be7anaw danda7ibeenna.
Yesuusa be7anaw koyidi I biya ogiyas sinthe woxi bidi issi boobba mitha bolla keyis.
Yesuusi he bessaa gakishe dhoqu gidi be7idi, “Zakiyoosa, hachi ta ne son pee7anaw bessiya gisho elle wodha” yaagis.
I ellesi wodhidi ufaysan Yesuusa mokis.
He bessan de7iya asaa ubbay hessa be7idi, “Nagaranchuwa soo gelidi moketaniw hanees” yaagidi zuuzumidosona.
Gidoshin, Zakiyoosi eqidi Godaako, “Godaw, Heko taw de7iya shalo ubbaafe baggaa manqotas immana. Asape aybaka wordon balethada ekidaba gidiko oyddu kushe zaarana” yaagis.
Yesuusi qassi, “Ha uray Abrahaame na7a gidida gisho hachi atotethay ha soo yis.
Asa Na7ay yiday dhayidaysa koyanaasanne ashshanaasa” yaagis.
Tammu Minaane Leemiso
Asay hessa si7iya wode, Yesuusi Yerusalaame matatida gishonne Xoossaa kawotethay ha77i matara qoncana daanida gisho entaw leemiso odis.
Hessa gisho, Yesuusi, “Issi gita asi de7eysi baw kawotethi ekidi yaanaw hara biitta bis.
Iyaw oothiya aylletape tammata xeegidi issuwas issuwas tammu minaane
immidi ‘Ta simmada yaana gakanaw ha miishiyara zal7ite’ yaagis.
“He biitta asay iya ixiya gisho, ha uray nu bolla kawotana mela nu koyoko yaagidi ase iya guyera kiittidosona.
“Gidoshin, he uray kawo gididi ba biitta simmis. He tammu aylleti I immida miishiyan ay mela zal7idi wodhisidaako eranaw koyidi entana xeegisis.
“Koyroysi yidi, ‘Godaw, ne taw immida miishey haraa tamma wodhis’ yaagis.
“Iya Goday, ‘Neno ammanetida aylliyaw lo77o oothadasa. Neeni guuthaban ammanetida gisho new tammu katamata bolla maata immas’ yaagis.
“Nam7anthoy yidi, ‘Godaw, ne taw immida miishey haraa ichasha wodhis’ yaagis.
“Goday iyako, ‘Newuka qassi ichashu katamata bolla maata immas’ yaagis.
“Heko heedzanthoy yidi, ‘Godaw, ta curqan xaaxada naagida ne miishiya hannashu.
Ayis giiko, neeni nebaa gidonnaba ekeysanne ne zeronnaba cakiya iita asi gidiya gisho new yayyas’ yaagis.
“Iya goday zaaridi, ‘Neno iita aylliyaw ne doonatho ta nena pirdana. Ta wothonnaba ekeysanne zeronnaba cakiya asi gideysa ne eriko,
ta yada ta miishiya wodhera ekana mela zal7iya asaas ayis immabikii?’
“Iya goday he bessan eqidaysatako, ‘Iyara de7iya miishiya ekidi tamma wodhisidaysas immite’ yaagis.
“Enti, ‘Godaw, iyaw kaseka tammu minaaney de7ees’ yaagidosona.
“Goday, ta hintew odayis; ‘De7iya ubbaas hari guzhetana, shin baynaysafe haray atto iyaw de7iyaraka eketana.
Gidoshin, ta enta bolla kawotonna mela koydaysata he ta morketa ha ta sinthe ehidi gora7ite’ gis” yaagis.
Gita Bonchon Yerusalaame Geluwa
Yesuusi hessa odidaape guye, entafe sinthe hemetidi Yerusalaame bis.
Shamaho zuma
bolla de7iya Beetefaagenne Bitaane matida wode ba tamaaretape nam7ata kiittidi,
“Hinte sinthan de7iya gutaa biite, hinte yaa gakiya wode oonika toggonna qashetidi de7iya hare mari demmana. Iya billidi haa eki yiite.
Oonika, ‘Ayis billeetii?’ gidi oychiko, ‘Goday iya koyees’ yaagite” yaagis.
Kiitetidaysati bidi I gidaysada hanin be7idosona.
Enti hare maraa billishin godati be7idi, “Hare maraa ayis billeetii?” yaagidosona.
Enti zaaridi, “Goday iya koyees” yaagidosona.
Yaape hare maraa Yesuusako ehidosona. Banta ma7uwa hare maraa zokon yeggidi Yesuusa hare maraa bolla utisidosona.
Asayka I biya ogiya bolla banta ma7uwa hiixidosona.
Shamaho zuma dugethe wodhisiya ogiyako matiya wode, taybon keehi daro asay enti be7ida malaalsiyaban ufaytidi banta qaala dhoqu oothidi,
yaagidi Xoossaa galatidosona.
Asaa giddofe issi issi Farsaaweti Yesuusako, “Astamaariyaw, ne tamaareta hayzite gada hanqeta” yaagidosona.
I entako, “Enti si77i giiko shuchati waassana” yaagis.
Yesuusi Yerusalaame matishe katamaa be7idi iyaw yeekis.
“New saro gidanaysa hachi ne eridaba gidiyakoshin, ha77i ne ayfiyape geemmis.
Ne morketi ne yuushuwa diridi dumma dumma ogiyara nena teqidi un7ethiya wodey yaana.
Nenanne ne dirsaa garsan de7iya ne nayta dhaysana. Issi issi shuchu denthidi laallana, ayis giiko Xoossay nena ashshanaw yaa wodiya erabaaka” yaagidi iw yeekis.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi Xoossa Keethi gelidi zal7eyisata yaape goodis.
Qassi, “ ‘Ta keethay Xoossaa woossiya keethi gidana’ gidi xaafetis, shin hinte ta keethaa pangata gongolo oothideta” yaagis.
Gallas gallas xoossa keethan tamaarsees. Kahineta halaqati, higge astamaaretinne deriya cimati iya wodhanaw oge koyoosona.
Gidoshin, asa ubbay iya timirtiya banta wozana yeggidi si7iya gisho, entaw oothanabay dhayis.

footnotes.text: Minaane: Minaaney Girike doona. Issi minaaney issi gallasa oosanchos heedzu ageena damooze gidees.
Shamaho zuma: Shamahoy daro doliya zuma guussu.
